'git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix cache corruption under concurrent writes

The CacheStore wrote content and metadata as two separate non-atomic
fs::write calls.  When multiple processes (or threads) stored the same
cache entry concurrently, the content file could come from one writer
while the metadata (including size_bytes) came from another, leaving
the cache in an inconsistent state.

Two changes fix the race:

1. Atomic writes — both content and metadata are now written to a
   temporary file first and then renamed into place, so readers never
   see a half-written file.

2. File locking — store() and update() acquire a per-entry exclusive
   lock (flock on Unix) before writing, serializing concurrent writers
   to the same entry.

A secondary TOCTOU race in load() (exists-then-read) is also removed;
it now handles NotFound inline.
EOF
